'''Martin Terwilliger''' (also published as '''Marty Terwilliger'''; '''Marty Twigg''') of Albany played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000, finishing 9th with 8 points (+55).<ref name="ramapo2000">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ RamapoCon II Day 2 Director's Report], Scott Lingrell, DeckTech (13 May 2000).</ref> His son [[Brian Terwilliger]] played him at the [[1999 Battle of Midway]] ("My dad").<ref name="tr-d5" /> As Marty Terwilliger (Marty Twigg) he flew with [[Team Albany]] to [[DecipherCon 2000]] and printed the red McDonald's shirts with "Team Albany" on the front. Matt Sokol's trip report lists him as travel and family, not as a dested constructed member of the Sunday team event.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref> He played the [[2012 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/2012mpcday1.pdf 2012 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
